scope: Static PC/ISO comparison, isolated x86 ABI/lifecycle tests, and root live HUD/lifecycle validation. The c9b3 re-enable crash was diagnosed and the repaired lifecycle passed subsequent lobby and gameplay tests.

discovery.safezonex_safezoney: No matching cvars in this build; neither is used by the identified layout code.
discovery.panel_test_title_safe: Read-only live query returned 0 and cheat flag. This PC-only gate encloses the retained title-safe layout calculation. The implementation never changes the cvar.
discovery.mat_drawtitlesafe: Unknown console command in the running build. A separate engine binary overlay is unrelated to resource layout.
discovery.resource_contract: usetitlesafe absent/0 leaves the resource unchanged; 1 selects 5%, values greater than 1 select 7.5% of the full display surface.
discovery.existing_resource_flags: HUD resources already mark the intended controls, including CHudLocalPlayerDisplay, CHudTeamDisplay and AbilityTimer. Current MainMenu, GameLobby, FooterPanel and InGameMainMenu resources have no usetitlesafe flag. No new flags are added.

xbox_evidence.pc_only_difference: The Xbox path reads the resource flag directly without the PC panel_test_title_safe cvar gate.

pc_evidence.instruction_meaning: cmp dword ptr [ecx+0x30],edi; je +0x123 (EDI is zero and ECX is the ConVar parent)
pc_evidence.native_algorithm: Obtain viewport dimensions, temporarily remove the surface-size override to read the full display dimensions, then restore the override. Compare viewport origin and parent dimensions to identify outside edges. Apply the selected percentage only on outside edges; centered anchors remain centered. Native f/stretch dimensions also shrink by the applicable insets.
pc_evidence.example_1600x900_horizontal_split: For usetitlesafe=1, the native calculation uses 80-pixel outer left/right and 45-pixel outer top/bottom margins. The shared horizontal divider receives no extra 45-pixel inset.
pc_evidence.engine_copy_not_hooked: An engine.dll Panel copy exists at RVA0x2b2970, but this patch is limited to GameUI menus and client HUD layouts.

implementation.menu_scope: Installed and lobby::UseConsoleMenuPresentation(): explicitly enabled bridge and an owned offline session, or disconnected no-session main menu.
implementation.hud_scope: Installed, explicitly enabled bridge, and lobby::HasOwnedOfflineSession().
implementation.owned_behavior: Skip only the PC test-cvar comparison and enter the original resource-flag lookup and native title-safe calculation.
implementation.unowned_behavior: Execute the original comparison/jump through the MinHook trampoline, retaining the native test-cvar behavior.
implementation.machine_state: Naked x86 guards preserve all GPRs, EFLAGS, stack, x87 and SSE state using pushfd/pushad and an aligned 512-byte FXSAVE/FXRSTOR region.
implementation.configuration: No cvar, config file, input routing, font, resource flag or persistent panel setting is written.
implementation.fingerprint_gate: Both module accessors require matching complete binary hashes, and Install additionally verifies the exact nine-byte gate and callback prefixes.

refresh_lifecycle.hud_reload_callback: client+0xc2bc0, cdecl void(), prefix55 8b ec 83 ec 24. The native callback iterates both local client modes with its own split-screen context guard and also handles the full-screen mode.
refresh_lifecycle.menu_reload_callback: GameUI+0x16130, cdecl void(), prefix55 8b ec 51. Reloads active-frame resources; shared-scheme reload remains the original no-op.
refresh_lifecycle.enable: Install before input::Enable. Refresh is a no-op while enabled; subsequent native resource creation uses the installed gates without reinitializing a stale lobby.
refresh_lifecycle.explicit_disable: Clear bridge enabled flag first, then Refresh before teardown. HUD restoration requires observed owned HUD use and readable client globals. Menu restoration additionally requires observed menu use and a non-null native MatchFramework v9 session. Remove hooks, then Shutdown.
refresh_lifecycle.normal_process_unload: Remove hooks and Shutdown without a late resource reload; UI interfaces may already be torn down.
refresh_lifecycle.callback_guards: Refresh rejects recursion, checks native interface objects and skips all enabled calls. Native GameLobby reload is forbidden without a live matchmaking session even when the cached panel is readable.

verification.independent_review: native_ui independently verified both instruction gates and continuations, original resource-flag execution, native callback ABI, register/FPU state preservation, scope and cleanup ordering; passed.
verification.compile: Standalone MSVC Win32 C++17 /W4 /EHsc /Od /UNDEBUG compile succeeded without diagnostics.
verification.isolated_abi_test: 32 menu/HUD dispatches across installed, enabled, menu-context and owned-session combinations passed. Each compares all seven general registers, EFLAGS, ESP and all 512 saved floating-point/SSE bytes. The logging double deliberately clobbers x87/XMM state. Missing-module install refusal and post-Shutdown refresh are also checked.
